Sandbox_RealisticCold_ClothingInsulation: How much warmth your clothes provide. 4 is the mod's baseline; lower means clothing protects less, higher means more. Below 1, even heavy gear feels thin; above 6, light layers feel like a winter coat.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_EnableFoodFreezing: Lets food freeze inside containers when the surrounding temperature drops below freezing. Experimental - may interact unpredictably with other food mods.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_SweatRateMultiplie: Scales how fast you produce sweat when overheating. 1.0 is the mod's baseline. Lower numbers mean less wetness from heat stress (and clothing stays drier); higher numbers mean you drench yourself faster.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_EvapCoolingStrengt: How much sweat actually cools your body as it evaporates. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables evaporative cooling entirely (sweat still soaks clothing but provides no cooling). Wind and dry air boost the effect; rain cancels most of it.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_InsulationSpreadBi: Controls how strongly uneven loadouts (e.g. parka + bare legs) deviate from the simple body-wide average. 0.0 = pure average (all parts treated equally); 1.0 = always pulled toward the weakest part in cold and the most-trapping part in heat. 0.30 is the recommended middle ground.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ConvectiveBridgeSt: Smoothes the warming-rate cliff right at normal body temperature. 1.0 is baseline. 0 disables the bridge, warming up from cold to normal feels fast, but heating past normal in hot air feels much slower.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_WarmingRateCapCPM_: Hard ceiling on how fast body temperature can rise from environmental warming (warm air, heaters, hot drinks combined). 0.5 °C/min is the default. Lower for slower recovery from cold; raise for instant warm-up at fires.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdSicknessMultip: Scales how badly a cold affects you (sickness moodle, infection rate). 1.0 is baseline. Higher = colds feel like the flu.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_CatchColdThreshold: Cold stage you need to reach before you can catch a cold. 1 = Chilly (easiest, most forgiving), 2 = Cold (default), 3 = Freezing, 4 = Hypothermia (only catch a cold if literally freezing to death).
Sandbox_RealisticCold_CatchColdRateMulti: How quickly the catch-a-cold meter fills once you're past the threshold. 1.75 is the default. Higher = colds catch faster.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdWorsenPerHour_: How quickly an untreated cold gets worse, in cold-strength points per game-hour. 45 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdRecoverPerHour: How quickly a cold improves while resting and warm. 24 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ColdMedicineDecayP: How quickly the effect of cold medicine fades. 36 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HypothermiaDamageI: Minimum game-hours between hypothermia damage ticks. Smaller = more frequent damage. 0.2 is the default (one tick every ~12 game-minutes).
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HypothermiaDamageP: Health lost per hypothermia damage tick. 0.2 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyAirThreshold: Air temperature at which the chilly warning can start firing. Below this, the moodle considers you exposed. Default 16°C.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyCoolingMulti: When clothing's cooling factor exceeds this fraction, you start to feel chilly. Lower = warning fires earlier (less protection feels colder sooner). 0.9 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ChillyInsulationTh: Average clothing insulation below which the chilly warning is allowed to fire. 1.5 is the default. Set higher to make the warning fire even with moderate clothing.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HeatTargetMaximum_: Warmest temperature any single heater will aim for in its room. 26°C is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_HeatDistanceExpone: How sharply heater warmth fades with distance. 1.0 is the default (linear). Higher = warmth stays close to the heater. Lower = heat reaches further.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_VehicleHeaterMaxDe: Vehicle Heater - Max Heat Above Outdoors (°C)
Maximum degrees above outdoor temperature that a running vehicle heater can produce. 25°C is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_IndustrialHeaterSp: Percent chance an industrial heater appears in large industrial buildings. Set to 0 to disable industrial-heater spawns entirely.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_ExposureCap_toolti: Maximum combined cold leakage allowed across all openings (windows + doors + gaps + curtains) in one room. Higher = drafty rooms can equalize to outdoor faster. 6.0 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightWindow: How much cold leaks through a closed window. 0.8 is the default. Higher = windowed rooms get colder.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightDoor_t: How much cold leaks through a closed door. 1.2 is the default. Higher = drafty doors.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightGap_to: How much cold pours through large structural gaps (broken walls, holes). 1.4 is the default.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_BreachWeightCurtai: How much cold leaks through a curtained-but-otherwise-open opening. 0.3 is the default - curtains help but aren't perfect.
Sandbox_RealisticCold_SealedPassiveTrans: Sealed Building - Passive Heat Transfer (1.0 = baseline)

How fast a fully sealed building (no broken windows, no open doors, no gaps) drifts toward the outside temperature through walls and ceiling. 1.0 is the mod's baseline. 0 = a sealed house holds its temperature forever; 2.0 = walls leak twice as fast even when sealed; 5.0 = even sealed homes equalize quickly. Has no effect on buildings with active leaks.
